summary: The final year on {director}'s street calendar extends beyond the projected life of the bond money.
realLife: Oakland estimated its infrastructure bond balance could run out before the bond term ended and said a replacement was needed for much of the mileage.
gates: The city manages the affected street and has the project facts described here.
inGame: The city highways budget records the appropriation change. needs: bond balance, spending forecast and street list by year.

turns.pulledBy: The city increases its street appropriation and the following records identify an eligible use: bond balance, spending forecast and street list by year.
turns.what: Move a later package into the funded column once replacement money is available.
turns.writesBack: Funding year and bond source by package.

turns.pulledBy: A smaller city appropriation requires the office to revisit the commitment documented by these records: bond balance, spending forecast and street list by year.
